p.i: deret,nisi de fide ageretur, ut quos fuasanctitas hæreticos esse iudicaret, ille statim vel proscribe-ret, vel occideret. Sanciuit quoq;, ne laici de cleri-corum vita iudicent (mirum bestiæ artificium) nec super pontificis potestate quicquam disputent. Ni-hil iuris in præsulem, magistratus Christianos ha-bere decreuit(ita se exaltabat Antichristus, diui-nam ordinationem conculcans pedibus ) eo quod pontifex, inquit, appelletur Deus. Anton.tit. 16. Præcepit ne Episcopi aut clerici bella gererent, sed orationi incumberent: ocio & luxui potius Re-diuinam Latino sermone celebrari iterum iussit: Sclauis tamen & Polonis, per dispensationem, in sua lingua fieri permisit. Sequentias in missa (can-tus puellares) primus approbauit: Gloria in excel-sis in cœnæ Dominicæ festo ad missam cantari man-dauit: & Romanorum pontificum decretis autho-ritatem Apostolicam addidit. Nuptias in publico celebrari præcepit, basilicam Mariæ nouæ repara-uit: D. Clementis corpus transtulit, & Bremen-sem Ecclesiam Hamburgensi coniunxit. A malis ministris sacramenta suscipi voluit: non tamen presbytero uxorem habente, quam hypocrita con-cubinam vocat. Per hanc immanem bestiam, sacer-dotes ad cœlibatum cogi primum cœperunt, sed ab Huldrico[?] episcopo Augustano, viro sanctissimo,

page.notes: The first word "fuasanctitas" is read as "sua sanctitas" with a long-s look-alike; the reading is probable but not certain. "Huldrico" is uncertain (could be Hildrico); marked [?]. "decreuit(ita" is printed without a space and is kept so. The page number "46" and running head are read from a small, stylised print and may vary slightly. The whole text is set in italic and treated as one paragraph, since no indent marks a new paragraph. The text ends mid-sentence at "sanctissimo," and continues on the next page with "per" as catchword.
